dialogues.jp: 「ただいま……と」
dialogues.en:
She bows her head, takes off her shoes, and arranges them
and my shoes nicely.
dialogues.text:
She bows her head, takes off her shoes, and arranges them
and my shoes nicely.

dialogues.jp:
無人の家に向かって声を投げかける。もっとも、
今は隣に人が居る訳だが。
dialogues.en: "Oh, you don't have to be so stiff and formal."
dialogues.text: "Oh, you don't have to be so stiff and formal."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、お邪魔します……」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
ぺこんと頭を下げると、靴を脱ぎ、靴を揃え、
ついで俺の靴も揃えた。
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Thank you...... Then... I won't."
dialogues.text: "Thank you...... Then... I won't."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、そ、その……」
dialogues.en: "What? About the shoes?"
dialogues.text: "What? About the shoes?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「そう……ですか？」
dialogues.en:
Our shoes are arranged nicely at the door, and they look
like as if we have guests.
dialogues.text:
Our shoes are arranged nicely at the door, and they look
like as if we have guests.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「何が？　靴？」

ちょこなんと揃えられた靴は、まるで来客でも
あったかのようだ。
dialogues.en:
"Oh, yeah, you don't have to do that. I mean, who does that,
you know?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, yeah, you don't have to do that. I mean, who does that,
you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah, yes...... You're right."
dialogues.text: "Ah, yes...... You're right."

dialogues.jp:
｛あいまい／曖昧｝に笑いつつ、しゃがんでぐしゃぐしゃと靴
をかき混ぜる。
dialogues.en:
She smiles ambiguously and scatters the shoes all over the
place.
dialogues.text:
She smiles ambiguously and scatters the shoes all over the
place.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、わざわざカオスにせんでも……」
dialogues.en: "You didn't have to do that either......"
dialogues.text: "You didn't have to do that either......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「え？　あ、す、すみません……」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh, I-I am sorry......"
dialogues.text: "What? Oh, I-I am sorry......"

dialogues.jp:
汗マークが飛び散っていそうなほど焦ると、頼
子さんは再び靴を揃えたのだった。
dialogues.en:
I can see her getting slightly panicked, with sweat marks
everywhere around her like in a cartoon. She bends down and
arranges the shoes nicely again.
dialogues.text:
I can see her getting slightly panicked, with sweat marks
everywhere around her like in a cartoon. She bends down and
arranges the shoes nicely again.

dialogues.jp:
「でまあ、さっきも言ったけど、今はこの家は
　俺一人なんだな」
dialogues.en:
"I told you earlier, but I'm the only one who lives in this
house."
dialogues.text:
"I told you earlier, but I'm the only one who lives in this
house."

dialogues.jp: 「二人っきりって事だけど、それでも、いい？」
dialogues.en:
"So, that means, only me and you in this house. Would that
be okay with you?"
dialogues.text:
"So, that means, only me and you in this house. Would that
be okay with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、だから、見知らぬ男女が一つ屋根の下
　にって事なんだぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"You know, it means a man and a woman are going to live
together under the same roof."
dialogues.text:
"You know, it means a man and a woman are going to live
together under the same roof."

dialogues.jp:
何をゐってゐるのでせうかこの異人さんは、と
いった感じの視線を送られてしまった。
dialogues.en:
She looks puzzled, as if she was saying "What is this
strange man talking about?".
dialogues.text:
She looks puzzled, as if she was saying "What is this
strange man talking about?".

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず頼子さんは、そっち方面の心配はし
ていないらしい。
dialogues.en: She seems not to care about those things...
dialogues.text: She seems not to care about those things...

dialogues.jp:
「ん〜、まあいいか。何にしろ、追い出す訳に
　もいかんし……」
dialogues.en: "Umm... oh well. I can't kick you out anyway."
dialogues.text: "Umm... oh well. I can't kick you out anyway."

dialogues.jp: 身体をぴくんと震わせた。
dialogues.en: She shakes her body.
dialogues.text: She shakes her body.

dialogues.jp:
上目遣い。とても頼りない。微妙に苦手な視線
で、俺は半歩下がった。
dialogues.en:
She gives me puppy dog eyes, looking desperate. It
disconcerts me, so I step back a little.
dialogues.text:
She gives me puppy dog eyes, looking desperate. It
disconcerts me, so I step back a little.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「ま、まあ、落ち着いて」
dialogues.en: "C-Calm down."
dialogues.text: "C-Calm down."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はい。その……すいません」
dialogues.en: "Uh, yes. I...... I am sorry."
dialogues.text: "Uh, yes. I...... I am sorry."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「いや、まあ、いいんだけど」
dialogues.en: "It's okay."
dialogues.text: "It's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: （にしても、長い｛まつげ／睫毛｝だな……）
dialogues.en: (She does have very long eyelashes......)
dialogues.text: (She does have very long eyelashes......)

dialogues.jp:
無防備に目をつむり、必死に息を整えている。
窓から差し込む日で顔の造作が明らかだ。
dialogues.en:
She's trying to catch her breath, closing her eyes
defenselessly. Light from a window lets me get a good look
at her face.
dialogues.text:
She's trying to catch her breath, closing her eyes
defenselessly. Light from a window lets me get a good look
at her face.

dialogues.jp: 美人だな。
dialogues.en: She's a beautiful girl.
dialogues.text: She's a beautiful girl.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.en: "Ah."
dialogues.text: "Ah."

dialogues.jp:
ぱちりと目が開き、視線がトンネルのように通
じ合う。
dialogues.en:
She opens her eyes, and our eyes lock as if we were looking
through a tunnel.
dialogues.text:
She opens her eyes, and our eyes lock as if we were looking
through a tunnel.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、と、ですね……ですから、私……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, I... was going... to say......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, I... was going... to say......"

dialogues.jp:
ふと見ると、頼子さんの両手は白っぽく見える
くらい固く握られていた。
dialogues.en:
Her hands are clasped tightly together, and they're getting
white.
dialogues.text:
Her hands are clasped tightly together, and they're getting
white.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「私……私を……メイドとしてここに置いて下
　さい……！」
dialogues.en: "Please...... Please let me stay here as your maid......!"
dialogues.text: "Please...... Please let me stay here as your maid......!"

dialogues.jp: まあ、メイド服着てるしな。
dialogues.en: Well, she certainly is wearing a maid costume.
dialogues.text: Well, she certainly is wearing a maid costume.

dialogues.jp:
「というか、別にメイドさんなんてしてくれな
　くてもいいぜ？」
dialogues.en: "You don't have to be my maid to stay here."
dialogues.text: "You don't have to be my maid to stay here."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、そんなチワワみたいに、不安そうな顔
　せんでも」
dialogues.en: "Don't look so anxious like a chihuahua."
dialogues.text: "Don't look so anxious like a chihuahua."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「で、でも、私……」

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「メイドじゃ……なかったら……私……」
dialogues.en: "If I'm not your maid...... then I......"
dialogues.text: "If I'm not your maid...... then I......"

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「いや、だから別にそういう仕事なんかしなく
　ても、家に置くって」
dialogues.en:
"What I'm trying to say is that I'll let you stay here even
if you're not my maid."
dialogues.text:
"What I'm trying to say is that I'll let you stay here even
if you're not my maid."

dialogues.jp:
ふるふると首を振る。この人には、精一杯の否
定なんだろうなと思えた。
dialogues.en:
She shakes her head to the sides. I think this is how she
expresses her strongest denial.
dialogues.text:
She shakes her head to the sides. I think this is how she
expresses her strongest denial.

dialogues.jp: 「ええと、むしろ、メイドとして働きたい？」
dialogues.en: "......Okay, so you'd rather work here as a maid?"
dialogues.text: "......Okay, so you'd rather work here as a maid?"

dialogues.jp:
まさかなと思いつつ、｛たず／訊｝ねる。しかし、おお、
見よ！　頼子さんは、うんうんと頷いているで
はないか。
dialogues.en:
I'm not sure, but I ask her anyway. But look at her! She's
nodding in agreement!
dialogues.text:
I'm not sure, but I ask her anyway. But look at her! She's
nodding in agreement!

dialogues.jp: ……マジで？
dialogues.en: ...Is she serious?
dialogues.text: ...Is she serious?

dialogues.jp:
「けど、参ったな。俺んち、メイドさん雇うよ
　うな余裕ないぜ？」
dialogues.en: "But I can't afford to hire a maid."
dialogues.text: "But I can't afford to hire a maid."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そ、それはいいんです。お、置いてもら
　えるだけで……」
dialogues.en: "Ah, you don't have to. You can just let me stay here."
dialogues.text: "Ah, you don't have to. You can just let me stay here."

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「給料はいらないと？」
dialogues.en: "You don't want any money?"
dialogues.text: "You don't want any money?"

dialogues.jp: ｛しんし／真摯｝な｛まなざ／眼差｝しでこくんと頷く。
dialogues.en: She nods with a sincere look on her face.
dialogues.text: She nods with a sincere look on her face.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、ま、いいかな……」
dialogues.en: "Well, then that's fine with me......"
dialogues.text: "Well, then that's fine with me......"

dialogues.jp:
家事の全般を担当していてくれた音夢が居なく
なった事だし。丁度いいと言えばいい。
dialogues.en:
Since Nemu, who used to do all the housework, is gone now,
it'll work just fine for me.
dialogues.text:
Since Nemu, who used to do all the housework, is gone now,
it'll work just fine for me.

dialogues.jp:
尤も、そういう打算なしでも俺は断れなかった
だろう。頼子さんには、そういう雰囲気がある
のだ。
dialogues.en:
Even if it didn't work fine for me, I still couldn't say no
to her. Yoriko-san has such a mysterious atmosphere that
makes it difficult for me to say no.
dialogues.text:
Even if it didn't work fine for me, I still couldn't say no
to her. Yoriko-san has such a mysterious atmosphere that
makes it difficult for me to say no.

dialogues.speaker: Yoriko
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Th-Thank you so much."
dialogues.text: "Th-Thank you so much."

dialogues.jp:
それまでの不安顔とのコントラストも鮮やかに、
頼子さんが微笑む。
dialogues.en:
The anxious face is gone now, and she has a smile on her
face.
dialogues.text:
The anxious face is gone now, and she has a smile on her
face.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、と、じゃあひとつ、俺からお願いが」
dialogues.en: "Oh, then I have one favor to ask you."
dialogues.text: "Oh, then I have one favor to ask you."

dialogues.jp:
「メイドさんって言っても、“ご主人様”とか
　“旦那様”は勘弁してな。普通に名前で呼ん
　でくれればいいから」
dialogues.en:
"Please don't call me Master or Mr. You can call me Junichi,
okay?"
dialogues.text:
"Please don't call me Master or Mr. You can call me Junichi,
okay?"

dialogues.jp: ◆メイドさんが家へ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Junichi◆
dialogues.text: ◆Junichi◆

dialogues.jp: 頼子さんを連れて家に帰ってきた。
dialogues.en:
I say to an empty house as usual. Well... but today there's
someone beside me.
dialogues.text:
I say to an empty house as usual. Well... but today there's
someone beside me.

dialogues.jp:
頼子さんは、給料はいらないので、置いてもら
う代わりにメイドとして俺の家で働きたいとい
い出す。
dialogues.en: "This is my house. I live here alone right now."
dialogues.text: "This is my house. I live here alone right now."

dialogues.jp:
そして俺はその申し出を受け入れることにした
のだった。
dialogues.en: "Thank you......"
dialogues.text: "Thank you......"
